summary: Rule v1.5 (contract section 29, test id R21), designer request 'la partie dans laquelle l'ennemi n'est pas ne lui appartient plus': when the captures of one section 6 step a group take cells from a living player and split its territory, the player keeps one piece per split territory (the piece of its anchor: the pawn's cell when it stands on its land, else the cell it left home from while trailing; the largest piece when the anchor is in no piece of that split) and the other pieces become neutral (default) or the cutter's. Option SimConfig.SeveredTerritory (SeveredTerritoryRule Off / Neutral / Capturer). New event TerritorySevered. Off reproduces every pinned hash of the previous Core exactly. The probe hash 246577239DE179C4 is unchanged with the default (the scripted demo contains no split, reproduced headless). No Runtime change was needed.

rule.who: every living player that loses at least one cell to another player's capture in a step a group (human and bots alike); the ordinary capture, the lasso pocket validated at the return, cells added by AugmentCapture traits and the ReturnsBeforeRoundEnd path all go through step a
rule.trait_paths: no trait takes cells from a living rival outside step a: Propagation grows only into neutral cells, Coalescence fills only neutral holes (inside the capture, so it is judged), KillInheritance moves the cells of a dead victim, ScorchedEarth only marks cells; eliminations never sever
rule.connectivity: 8-adjacency (dual of the 4-connected outside flood of section 7 and the adjacency of the D1 rim; cells touching at a corner are one piece)
rule.judged_pieces: only pieces produced by this split: pieces = 8-components of the victim's cells after the captures; two pieces are in one split group when one pre-transfer 8-component (remaining old cells + lost cells) spans both; pieces that touch no lost cell (older islands, inherited land) are never visited
rule.anchor: read on the grid before the captures: the pawn's current cell at uG if the victim owns it (home, or returning at this instant); a home victim crossing out at this instant: the last own cell of its visit list; a trailing victim: TerritorySplit.ExitCell(Trail.Points[0]) = the owned cell among those whose closed square contains the exit point (lowest index), else the cell containing it
rule.fallback: anchor cell in no piece of the group: the largest piece (most cells, ties: lowest cell index)
rule.fresh_capture: a piece holding cells the victim gained in the same group (its own simultaneous return, R18) is never severed
rule.recipient: SeveredTerritoryRule.Neutral (default): plain neutral, never scorched (a running ScorchedEarth scorch on such a cell is forgotten); Capturer: the cutter = the lowest-index returner of the group that took a lost cell of that territory; Off: pre-v1.5 behaviour, bit-identical
rule.order_in_step_a: captures written (after the R18 conflict rule), Return events, severance (all victims analysed first, then all changes written), TerritorySevered events, R9 stolen-home exits, TerritoryLost eliminations
rule.event: SimEventType.TerritorySevered (appended at the end, value 16): Time = group time, Player = victim, Other = cutter, Recipient (new SimEvent field, -1 otherwise) = receiving player or -1 when neutral, Cells = severed cells ascending; one event per victim and cutter
rule.never_eliminates: the kept piece never loses a cell, so a split never eliminates anyone

runtime.territory_field: TerritoryField.Update reconciles every cell whenever sim.Grid.Version changes (Reconcile, dirty rectangles): severed cells leave the victim's color on the next frame. They snap off (no fill wave, no 0.6 s evaporation fade like an eliminated player's puddle) and with Capturer they appear in the cutter's color at once. The first reconcile logs '[PainterIO] TerritoryField reconciled N cell(s) with the grid' once per bind (informational, no test or verify step checks it). Re-checked after another agent modified TerritoryField.cs during this task: the Grid.Version reconcile is still there (line 398).
runtime.hud_leaderboard_results: Hud polls AreaPercent / RankOf / CountOf every frame (area count-up animates down too), the leaderboard and rival label too, GameDirector.HumanOutcome and Simulation.EndRound read OwnerGrid counts: all see the new owners immediately
runtime.win_detection: a split never eliminates, so LastSurvivor / AllEliminated are unaffected; TimeUp ranks read CountOf

determinism: result depends only on the grid, the captured cells and the anchor (fixed scan and neighbour order, union-find with lowest-index roots, cells sorted); identical events, severed cells and grid bytes at 30, 60 and 144 Hz; twin runs give identical StateHash; the option is not hashed (equal states, equal hashes; Off is bit-identical). Hot path: CollectSevered runs only for groups with returns and stops at once when no returner took a rival cell; TerritorySplit uses per-thread pooled stamped arrays (no grid-sized allocation per call), and stops as soon as all frontier seeds joined one piece.
edge_cases: home victim whose pawn cell is captured: R9 stolen exit (TerritoryStolen + Exit, after TerritorySevered) and the largest piece is kept
trailing victim: the piece of its exit cell is kept even if it is the smaller one and the pawn is far away; if the exit cell was taken since, the largest piece
victim returning at the same instant (R18): its fresh capture is never severed; its anchor is its return cell
an island split while the pawn is on another island: that island keeps its largest piece, the rest of the land is not judged
older islands that touch no lost cell are never judged (inherited land, pieces left by Off)
two cutters of one territory in one group: the lowest index is the cutter (and the recipient with Capturer); one event per victim and cutter
a victim that loses all its cells is eliminated by R9 as before (nothing to sever)
R18 contested cells keep their owner, so they are not lost and cannot split anyone
severed cells that were scorched before the victim captured them are plain neutral (scorch forgotten)

large severances happen: in the TraitsClassicTests bot round seed 7 (default rules) 6 severances removed 29787 cells in total, because the kept piece is the anchor's piece even when it is the smaller one
open_questions: Presentation: TerritorySevered has no dedicated visual, sound or toast yet (cells snap off through the reconcile). Suggested for the Runtime owners: an evaporation-style fade of the event's Cells (TerritoryField), toasts 'Ton domaine a été coupé !' / 'Tu as coupé le domaine de X !', a soft sound.

Trailing anchor: the designer said 'la partie dans laquelle l'ennemi n'est pas'; for a trailing victim the piece of its exit cell is kept (decision given). Alternatives: the piece nearest the pawn, or the largest piece.
Coalescence: should severed fragments enclosed by the cutter's land be filled at once (they are filled at its next unchased return)?
Bots do not value splits in their excursion or attack planning (BotController unchanged); they can now lose big pieces. The section 9 bot targets still pass.

No hidden test setting / SaveData / command line switch for SeveredTerritory (Runtime files owned by the wave D agents); the default Neutral applies to rounds, attract and probe through SimConfig defaults.
